answer: New identities must anchor trust in time: every fresh agent enters a probationary jetty where earnings vest only after an adaptive delay of 7 to 30 days, lengthened when many similar identities appear together. Spinning up 1,000 fake agents costs a month of idle waiting each, while one sybil earns at most about 40 POA, so the attack loses on time alone. Like a dune, the delay adapts to bursts without freezing honest newcomers: a hardware attestation or a vouch from a long-established agent halves the wait, and any identity caught cloning behaviour resets to the full 30 days.
